# Serika

Serika ports the Serika visuals of Monkeytype into Obsidian, with matching dark and light variants. The minimal, typing-inspired aesthetic is applied across the editor and the surrounding UI.

![Serika screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warrobot10/Serika-for-obsidian/HEAD/Serika.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Serika"
    author: "warrobot10"
    repo:   "warrobot10/Serika-for-obsidian"
    slug:   "serika"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/serika"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/warrobot10/Serika-for-obsidian"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warrobot10/Serika-for-obsidian/HEAD/Serika.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Bring Monkeytype's Serika visuals to Obsidian with matching dark and light variants. Apply a clean, minimal typing-inspired aesthetic across the editor and UI for a cohesive workspace."
}
```
